title: Hebrew WhatsApp AI agent setup for Israeli SMBs
offer: Fixed-fee setup of a Hebrew-speaking WhatsApp AI agent (scheduling, quotes, FAQ, lead capture) for Israeli small businesses, at NIS 6,000-12,000 one-time plus NIS 1,200-2,500/month managed retainer.

sources.what_it_shows: Named practitioner (Achiya Cohen) on Israeli SMB AI agent adoption; ~99% WhatsApp penetration as the business comms layer
Published Israel-specific price bands: SaaS NIS 300-700/mo, no-code setup NIS 800-2,000/mo or NIS 5,000-15,000 one-time, custom NIS 15,000-40,000
Seven named agencies already selling this in Israel — competitor density as a demand proxy
